name: M3M Mansion
summary: The project, M3M as developer, Sector 113 on Dwarka Expressway, the RERA number GGM/802/534/2024/29, the RERA possession date of 28 February 2032, the ₹3.59 Cr starting price, the 10-acre land area and the 8 towers are confirmed. The project has a second RERA registration (GGM/916/648/2025/19), so our single number covers only one phase. Our 1,000-unit count matches no source (961, 1,205 and about 1,212 are cited), and portals market possession earlier, in 2030.
